description: Off-voice check with no profile: score up to three pieces against a main piece. Each piece is pasted text (120+ words) or a public URL. Returns per-piece `score` (0-1: 0.8+ on voice, 0.55-0.8 drifting, below 0.55 off voice), `band`, `top_differences` and `top_matches` with the measured numbers, plus `notes`. Cite the numbers, do not invent detail. Free; 5 checks an hour per network (shared with check_voice_match).

others.description: One to three pieces to score against the main piece (text or url each).
